en-US.description: A terminal based media player with album art and video support.
en-US.longDescription:
SparkPlayer is a media player for every day use that's fun to use and looks nice. Point it at your on-disk media library and it just works: it opens to your music or video directory, browses your folders, plays virtually every media format you own, and keeps your playlist a single keypress away. No setup ceremony, no library import, no fuss.
Enjoy eleven colorful audio visualizers (FFT bars, mirrored bars, a radial spectrum, waveforms, spectrograms, a stereo X/Y scope, VU meters, a 3D spectrum, an audio-reactive plasma, even a spinning cassette tape), embedded album art rendered as real graphics, and video playback right in the terminal. On terminals with a graphics protocol you get true images; everywhere else SparkPlayer falls back to 24-bit-color halfblocks so it still works, anywhere.
Highlights:
- Easy to use — opens to your music directory, browse-and-play, helpful help overlay (?), sensible keyboard shortcuts.
- Great daily driver — lightweight, fast, and built to be your main player for a local music library. Filter long lists with /, edit and save your playlist, and it picks up where you left off next time you open it.
- Lots of formats — common audio, video, and playlist formats all supported out of the box.
- Graphics in the terminal — album art and video as real images on capable terminals, with a colored-halfblock fallback for everything else.
- Fun — a pile of visualizers to flip through while you listen.
- Runs in the browser too — there's a WASM build (see below).

zh-CN.description: 支持专辑封面和视频播放的终端媒体播放器。
zh-CN.longDescription:
SparkPlayer 是一款适合日常使用的媒体播放器，外观精美且趣味十足。只需将其指向本地磁盘中的媒体库，它就能直接运作：打开你的音乐或视频目录，浏览文件夹，播放你拥有的几乎所有媒体格式，并支持通过单个按键即时呼出播放列表。无需复杂的设置仪式，无需导入曲库，毫无繁琐负担。
尽享 11 种炫彩音频可视化效果（FFT 柱状图、镜像柱状图、放射状频谱、波形图、声谱图、立体声 X/Y 示波器、VU 表、3D 频谱、音频感应等离子效果，甚至还有旋转的磁带），直接在终端中以真实图形渲染内嵌专辑封面并播放视频。在支持图形协议的终端上，你将获得真正的图像；而在其他终端中，SparkPlayer 会回退至 24 位真彩色半字符块模式，确保随时随地皆可正常使用。
亮点：
- 简单易用 —— 直接定位至音乐目录，即扫即播，提供实用的帮助浮层（?）以及符合直觉的快捷键。
- 绝佳的主力播放器 —— 轻量、快速，专为成为本地音乐库的主力工具而打造。支持使用 / 筛选长列表、编辑并保存播放列表，并在下次打开时自动从中断处继续播放。
- 支持丰富格式 —— 开箱即用支持常见的音频、视频及播放列表格式。
- 终端图形渲染 —— 在兼容的终端上以真实图像呈现专辑封面与视频，其他终端则回退至彩色半字符块渲染。
- 趣味十足 —— 听歌时可随意翻阅切换丰富的可视化效果。
- 亦可在浏览器中运行 —— 提供 WASM 构建版本（见下文）。
